verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's own marketing says it helps you understand production systems using natural language and names Grafana Assistant as an AI capability. Nothing in the evidence shows that a natural-language question returns a real query (PromQL/LogQL) or a chart. The Knowledge Graph's 'no complex queries required' insights and the MCP server for external agents belong to other stories and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation that natural-language questions produce real queries or charts, depth of the Assistant feature, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Understand production systems faster using natural language
